The Starcoin Move framework

items.description: A Move framework is the set of Move modules included in the genesis state of the chain. These modules typically implement key concepts like accounts, currencies, . The ability to separate blockchain-specific framework logic from the generic functionality of the Move language is a key part of Move's platform-agnostic design.
